I'm a horrible typist, and I can't ever see my fingers when I type. I'm actually leaving this note in Wispr Flow right now on the review period. I'm hoping it comes through correctly. I have a high level of confidence that it will. 

But I have to tell you that all of my responses via text messages, as well as my iMessages on my Mac, have made me about 40% more efficient because I never learned to type. I can't ever see my keyboard, so this thing works amazing. If you're not already using Wispr Flow, you should be!
